topology.a_d_e_and_chain_host: node A, the room's authority (tosmr-a, <ns-a>), and the filler joiners D (tosmr-d, <ns-d>) E (tosmr-e, <ns-e>) and F (tosmr-f, <ns-f>) in network namespaces on bridge tosmr-br0 (host end <ns-bridge>); each routes through the host, which forwards and masquerades only TCP to the two relays' TLS port (tagged iptables rules, removed at the end); the three validators listen on 127.0.0.1, JSON-RPC ports [49880, 49881, 49882]
topology.b_host: node B, a member, on a separate VPS over SSH
topology.c_host: node C, a member, on another VPS over SSH (relay2's host; see shared_host_statement)
topology.remote_nodes: B's and C's files sit inside one scratch directory per host (<base>/<run>, 0700), removed at the end; their processes run as root there under the run's supervisor; the chain's JSON-RPC reaches each only through an SSH reverse tunnel bound to its 127.0.0.1
topology.relays: two installed tos-service-packet-relay units on two VPS, TLS under the pinned test CA; the run neither starts nor stops them
topology.firewall: A, D and E: outgoing only to the relays' TLS port and the forwarder ports, no incoming connection, and a host bridge table drops every frame between them; B's and C's host firewalls are untouched (the run stops processes rather than cutting connections)
topology.files: B's and C's node files are at the same absolute path on every host: staged once and mirrored back to this host read-only (rsync over SSH), so the harness reads their journals, chat outboxes, cards and logs; owner keys and Endpoint keys are never copied back
topology.thermal_guard: pauses and resumes this host's run and validators; B, C and the relays are not paused

not_openfox: creating, funding and activating the wallets with tosctl and the zerostate faucet
each node's Messaging Endpoint identity and its commitment on chain (scripts/messenger-relay-e2e-tool identity; tosctl agent native-registry action --kind delegate)
signing owner decisions with the owner key (tos-messenger-owner sign) and issuing C's invites (tos-messenger-owner prepare-invite and submit), as each node's owner
the network namespaces, firewall rules, forwarders and the relay daemons
the Messenger runtime calls (scripts/messenger-relay-e2e-tool call): this script is the Agent runtime of every node
the crafted room objects (scripts/messenger-relay-e2e-tool room-frames and craft) and this script's relay reads and deposits
staging B's and C's node files to their hosts and mirroring them back (rsync over SSH), the supervisor that runs their processes there, and the SSH reverse tunnels for their chain RPC
the harness's tosctl actions for B and C (the delegations) run on A's host with a copy of each vault: the wallets were created there before they were staged
the relay units' state, logs and metrics, read on the relay hosts (read-only tar, journalctl, curl to 127.0.0.1)
